title: The 10 Best Cordless Drill and Impact Driver Combo Kits
subtitle: Two-tool drill and impact driver kits with batteries and charger, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A combo kit pairs a drill/driver with an impact driver, two batteries and a charger, the starter set for most cordless tool owners. We ranked 10 best-sellers from DEWALT, Makita, CRAFTSMAN and Greenworks on rating, review volume and features (brushless motors, two batteries, a 1/2-inch drill chuck and a bag or case). Choose the battery platform first; it decides which tools you can add later.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Cordless Drill and Impact Driver Combo Kit, 2 Batteries, Charger and Bag (DCK240C2)

specs.extras: Charger, bag; impact 5.55 in long, 2.8 lb

products.verdict: The best-selling and most-reviewed kit here by a mile, with 61,416 reviews: DEWALT's compact drill and impact driver with two batteries, a charger and a bag.
products.best_for: First-time buyers who want the most proven kit on the biggest battery platform.
products.skip_if: You want brushless motors; the DCK277D2 or a FUEL kit has them.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Power Tool Combo Kit, 7-Tool Cordless Power Tool Set with 2 Batteries and Charger (CMCK700D2)

specs.tools: 7 tools incl. 1/2 in drill, impact driver, reciprocating saw, 6-1/2 in circular saw, oscillating tool

products.verdict: A seven-tool V20 starter shop: a 1/2-inch two-speed drill, an impact driver, a reciprocating saw, a 6-1/2-inch circular saw and an oscillating tool among them, with two batteries and a charger.
products.best_for: Setting up a whole garage on one battery platform at once.
products.skip_if: You only need to drill and drive; a two-tool kit costs a third as much.

products.name: Greenworks 24V Brushless Drill/Driver and Impact Driver Combo, 2 x 2.0Ah USB-C Batteries

specs.extras: Batteries double as USB-C power banks

products.verdict: A brushless kit with a 400 in-lb drill and a 1,950 in-lb impact driver, plus two batteries that also work as USB-C power banks.
products.best_for: Greenworks yard-tool owners and budget buyers who want brushless.

products.name: Greenworks 24V Brushless Cordless Drill and 6.5" Circular Saw Combo Kit, (2) 2.0Ah USB-C Batteries, 65W Rapid Charger (CK322)

specs.extras: 65W charger; batteries double as USB-C power banks

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX 5-Tool Combo Kit: 1/2" Drill, 1/4" Impact Driver, Reciprocating Saw, Circular Saw, Oscillating Tool, Battery and Charger (DCK540D1)

specs.tools: DCD777 drill/driver + DCF787 impact driver + DCS387 reciprocating saw + DCS391 circular saw + DCS356 oscillating tool

products.name: Makita CT225SYX 18V LXT Compact Cordless 2-Pc Combo Kit (1.5Ah)
products.verdict: Makita's compact kit: a 3.3 lb, 7-1/4-inch 1/2-inch drill with 480 in-lb, an impact driver, two batteries and a charger, for Makita's huge 18V LXT lineup.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Drill and Impact Driver Kit with 2 x 2.0Ah Batteries (DCK277D2)
products.verdict: A step up from the DCK240C2 with larger 2.0Ah batteries, the 1,500 in-lb DCF787 impact driver, a contractor bag and a 3-year warranty.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Drill and Impact Driver Set, 2Ah Battery and Charger (CMCK201D1)
products.verdict: CRAFTSMAN's newest V20 starter pair: a 1/2-inch drill/driver up to 1,700 rpm and a 1,800 in-lb impact driver, both with LEDs, sharing one 2Ah battery, plus a charger and a bag.
products.best_for: First-time buyers who want a name-brand drill and impact driver for under $80.
products.skip_if: You'll use both tools all day; with one battery you wait on the charger.
pros: $79 for a name-brand drill and impact driver

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX 3-Tool Brushless Combo Kit: Drill, Impact Driver, Oscillating Tool, 3 Batteries and Charger (DCK360D3)

specs.tools: Drill/driver (1/2 in) + impact driver + oscillating multi-tool

products.best_for: New DEWALT owners who want an oscillating tool for flush cuts and trim work along with the usual pair.

pros: Three batteries, so one is always charging

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX XR Brushless Hammer Drill and Impact Driver Combo Kit, 2 x 4Ah POWERPACK Batteries and Charger (DCK250QQ2)

specs.tools: Hammer drill (1/2 in, 2,000 rpm) + impact driver

products.verdict: DEWALT's strongest 20V pair here: the brushless DCD806 hammer drill, which DEWALT calls its most powerful 20V MAX hammer drill, and the 1,825 in-lb DCF845 impact driver, with two 4Ah POWERPACK batteries.
products.best_for: Remodelers and trades who drill into concrete and drive long lag screws.
products.skip_if: You mostly hang shelves and assemble furniture; the DCK240C2 does that for $149.

avoid.name: Cordless Impact Driver and Drill Combo Kit (Tool Only) Compatible with Dewalt 20V Max Battery, Up to 2300 In-lbs
avoid.flag: 'Combo kit' with no battery or charger; torque claim beats DEWALT's own
avoid.verdict: It's sold as a combo kit but includes no battery or charger, and claims more impact torque than DEWALT's own impact driver.
reasons: The listing says in bold that it does 'NOT INCLUDE BATTERY AND CHARGER, TOOL ONLY', while the title calls it a 'Combo Kit', which on the DEWALT and Makita kits here means batteries and charger in the box.
It claims up to 2,300 in-lbs from the impact driver, versus 1,500 in-lb for DEWALT's DCF787 in the DCK277D2, on the same DEWALT batteries.
DEWALT's own DCK240C2 kit, with two batteries, a charger and a bag, has 61,088 reviews.

buyers_guide.a: A drill and an impact driver cover nearly every drilling and driving job, and the kit price usually costs less than the two tools and batteries bought separately. More importantly, it puts you on a battery platform you'll use for future tools.
Pick the one whose other tools you'll want. DEWALT 20V MAX, Milwaukee M18 and Makita 18V LXT have the widest ranges. CRAFTSMAN V20, RYOBI ONE+ and Greenworks 24V are cheaper with fewer pro tools.
12V tools are smaller and lighter, great for cabinets, electrical and overhead work. 18V/20V tools have more power for big holes, long screws and masonry.
Yes if you use the tools often: brushless motors run cooler, last longer and get more work per charge. For occasional home use, a brushed kit like the DCK240C2 is fine.

buyers_guide.q: What does a hammer drill add?
buyers_guide.a: A hammer mode pounds as it spins, for drilling small holes in brick and concrete. It's useful for anchors; for big masonry holes, use a rotary hammer.
